title: The question-form guard checks a page task with options for its Departs-from line, even when the task carries context
why: The question-form guard skips page tasks that carry context, so a task with options can reach the owner with no Departs-from line.
source: coordinator 22:58 CST Nov 11, from lane question-form-departs-every (PR #2611)
note: Code change in the question-form guard (hooks/question_form.py). Found by the lane question-form-departs-every.
